description: Read the actual connected Medical API. Start with capabilities/connection to inspect reachability, authenticated contract and supported actions; unavailable routes are not assumed. day/summary accept today, tomorrow or YYYY-MM-DD in Europe/Prague. Modern APIs use canonical day endpoints; registration APIs return date-filtered records and status counts without guessing revenue. Dashboard metrics are diagnostic-session metrics, not appointment counts. Query calendars, activities, invoices, prices, appointments or specific patient names only when available. Never guess identity, diagnosis authorization or missing prices.
